playAlongInfo.title: About this practice

why.teacher_suggested: Your teacher suggested you practise this.
why.due: You've practised this before, and it's time to review it so it stays with you.
why.weak: You've started this, and it isn't secure yet. A few more takes will settle it.
why.new: Something new from your path, to start building it.
why.warm_up: Something you already play well, to get your hands going. It doesn't count toward your progress.
why.application: Putting what you know into music.
why.review_ahead: Nothing is due right now, so you're reviewing this a little early.
why.stretch: Nothing is due right now, and you're ready for this next step.

playAlongInfo.howTake: Each take starts with a bar of count-in, then you play along as the notes light up.
playAlongInfo.howRate: Afterwards, rate the take honestly: struggled, almost or clean.
playAlongInfo.howLadder: After two clean takes in a row the tempo goes up 5 BPM; after a struggle it comes down 5.
playAlongInfo.howWarmUp: A warm-up stays at the same tempo and doesn't count toward your progress.
playAlongInfo.howTempo: Too easy or too hard? Change the tempo before the next take.

tapCheck.title: Tap check
tapCheck.intro: For about 20 seconds, tap each fret as soon as it lights up. It tells us how long a tap takes you, so your answers are timed on what you know, not on your tapping.
